title: Base change between small etale sites is continuous; direct image preserves sheaves of sets
statement: Let $u:U\to V$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], $V_{\Et}$, $U_{\Et}$ the small etale sites [def-weil-pbc-etale-site] and $b:V_{\Et}\to U_{\Et}$, $W\mapsto U\times_VW$, $(g:W_1\to W_2)\mapsto\mathrm{id}_U\times g$, the base-change functor. Then: (1) $b$ sends coverings to coverings: if $\{W_i\to W\}_{i}$ is a covering of $V_{\Et}$ (etale morphisms over $V$, jointly surjective), then $\{U\times_VW_i\to U\times_VW\}_i$ is a covering of $U_{\Et}$; (2) for a morphism $W'\to W$ and a morphism $W''\to W$ of $V_{\Et}$ the canonical map $U\times_V(W'\times_WW'')\to(U\times_VW')\times_{U\times_VW}(U\times_VW'')$ is an isomorphism; (3) consequently $b$ is a continuous functor of sites (Stacks, Sites, Definition 00WV), and for every sheaf of sets $\mathcal F$ on $U_{\Et}$ the presheaf $u_*\mathcal F=\mathcal F\circ b$, $W\mapsto\mathcal F(U\times_VW)$, is a sheaf of sets on $V_{\Et}$; the sheaf condition of $u_*\mathcal F$ for a covering $\{W_i\to W\}$ is the sheaf condition of $\mathcal F$ for the covering $\{U\times_VW_i\to U\times_VW\}$. The same holds for sheaves of abelian groups and of commutative rings, whose sheaf condition is that of the underlying presheaf of sets.

source.place: Definition 00WV (definition-continuous: u continuous if it sends coverings to coverings and commutes with the fibre products of coverings) and Lemma 00WW (lemma-pushforward-sheaf: u^p of a sheaf is a sheaf for a continuous u, the sheaf conditions being the same); base change of etale coverings: literature/stacks-project/topologies.tex Lemma 0217 (lemma-etale: an etale covering base-changes to an etale covering) with Definition 0215 (definition-etale-covering) and Definition 021B (the small etale site)
